bias.en: Uptrend · rebound back to the SAR and October high
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 反弹至 SAR 与 10 月高点

read.en: Zscaler rose 7.8% on Oct 21 to $231.33, trading between $214.50 and $232.06. It is above the falling 5-day ($217.2), rising 10-day ($221.2), rising 30-day ($205.7), rising 100-day ($168.9) and falling 200-day ($165.8) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is above zero, with the histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($235.23), and RSI is 64.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月21日上涨 7.8%，收于 $231.33，盘中区间 $214.50–232.06。股价位于下行的 5 日（$217.2）、上行的 10 日（$221.2）、上行的 30 日（$205.7）、上行的 100 日（$168.9）和下行的 200 日均线（$165.8）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$235.23），RSI 为 64。

read.en: The close cleared the $217–221 zone (5 and 10-day averages, Sep 24 high), which now becomes support. Resistance is $235–237 (SAR, Oct 12 high $237.2), then $250 (round number). Support is $217–221, then $212.1 (Oct 15 low) and $203.4 (Oct 16 low). A close above $237.2 would flip the SAR and target $250; a close below $217 would reopen $212.
read.zh: 收盘突破 $217–221 区域（5 日和 10 日均线、9月24日高点），该区域转为支撑。阻力为 $235–237（SAR、10月12日高点 $237.2），其次 $250（整数关口）。支撑为 $217–221，其次 $212.1（10月15日低点）和 $203.4（10月16日低点）。若收盘站上 $237.2，SAR 将翻多，下一目标看 $250；若收盘跌破 $217，将重新打开 $212。
